provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 9401 GUILBEAU RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78250

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: At the time of inspection, the last sanitation inspection documented was 01/28/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Three out of ten children's files did not have updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: At the time of inspection, there was no current City of San Antonio Fire Inspection conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records for School-age or Pre-kindergarten: One of the five children files was missing documentation for current immunization record that is on file at the prekindergarten program or school the child attends.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records for School-age or Pre-kindergarten (26 TAC §746.625)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On the PreK playground against the building wall is a detached PVC pipe from the gutter that is accessible to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: At the time of inspection, the emergency practice for fire drills were unavailable for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The toddler teacher stated there were eight children in care when we verified there were nine children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One of the eight staff were missing form 2985 at the time of inspection.    One of the eight staff were missing form 2912 at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics: One of the seven staff was missing the following 2023-2024 trainings;  medication and bloodborne pathogens.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of the ten children were missing shot records at the time of inspection.   Two of the ten children were missing healthcare statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One of the ten children files were missing Emergency Care Authorization.  One of the ten children were missing Healthcare information.  Seven of the ten children were missing special care statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: Based on the Emergency Practice form the last documentation for testing smoke detectors carbon monoxide, and fire extinguishers was 8.26.24.     Based on the Emergency Practice form the last documentation for fire drill was on 9.10.24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: One of the eight staff files had an expired CPR training of 7.22.24
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: Licensing wasn't notified in writing, no later than five days after a change in director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: No documentation was available for review for carbon monoxide, smoke detectors, and fire extinguishers inspections.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of the ten children immunization records were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection found in the binder was conducted on 8.8.2021
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics: Trainings were unavailable at the time of inspection for four of the eight staff files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: At time of inspection, 4.22.24, a caregiver in an infant class was working directly with children without having received a determination of eligibility to be present at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: At time of inspection, a safety child alarm did not work in one of the two transportation buses for operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver at the operation demonstrated poor judgement when they closed the door to the classroom with children on the other side due to being frustrated over them not complying with putting their shoes on when asked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: A caregiver at the operation did not use positive methods of discipline when they mishandled a child at operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: During the course of an investigation it was determined that the operation failed to report to Child Care Regulation that a caregiver had been observed mishandling children in a way that could have resulted in injury to a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the course of the inspection it was observed a preschool teacher stepped away from her classroom to take children to restroom leaving her class unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: 2 children were left unsupervised in preschool classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based off interviews and records, the classroom a caregiver was supervising was out of ratio when the children woke up from nap and were taken to the restroom. The caregiver had 23 children between ages 3-9 years, when the max number of children one caregiver may supervise is 18 for this specified age group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Two children (3 and 4 years old)  were left unattended in a classroom while they were sleeping for about 5 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: Caregivers did not know who was responsible for a specific child during an incident on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Toddlers - Develop Self-help Skills: The operation is not giving a child who is potty trained opportunities to use a toilet while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Toddlers - Develop Self-help Skills (26 TAC §746.2507(8))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Reduction of Toilets/Sinks: The operation did not notify Licensing when they closed toilets used by children that were included in their original space computation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Reduction of Toilets/Sinks (26 TAC §746.301(3))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Outdoor Play: The outdoor playground was closed to children for an extended period of time due to ongoing pest control issue.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Outdoor Play (26 TAC §746.2607(1))

occurrences.finding: Location of Toilets: Children are not able to safely access the toilet in the toddler classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Toilets (26 TAC §746.4409)
